description.value: Red Cliff Farm is a small organic farm on the outskirts of Kamloops selling farm-fresh eggs and organically grown vegetables, including garlic varieties such as Red Russian and Music. The farm is home to free-ranging chickens and operates as a direct-to-consumer farm stand. Notably, it accepts Bitcoin payments via Lightning and on-chain, making it an unusual and locally distinctive stop for cyclists seeking fresh, organic food.

Organic Produce and Farm Fresh Eggs.
